chapters.title: Faithful in Babylon
chapters.summary: Daniel and his friends are taken to Babylon to be trained for the king's service. They refuse the king's food, eat vegetables, and God gives them wisdom.

chapters.title: The king's dream
chapters.summary: Nebuchadnezzar dreams of a great statue of gold, silver, bronze and iron, destroyed by a stone that becomes a mountain. God reveals it to Daniel: His kingdom will never be destroyed.

chapters.title: The fiery furnace
chapters.summary: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to bow to the golden image. Thrown into the furnace, they are unharmed, and a fourth figure walks with them in the fire.

chapters.title: Nebuchadnezzar humbled
chapters.summary: The proud king dreams of a great tree cut down. He loses his mind and lives like an animal until he acknowledges that the Most High rules.

chapters.title: The writing on the wall
chapters.summary: At Belshazzar's feast a hand writes on the wall. Daniel reads it: weighed in the balances and found wanting. That night Babylon falls.

chapters.title: The lions' den
chapters.summary: Daniel keeps praying to God despite a royal ban and is thrown to the lions. God shuts the lions' mouths, and King Darius praises Daniel's God.

chapters.title: Four beasts and the Son of Man
chapters.summary: Daniel sees four beasts rising from the sea, then the Ancient of Days on His throne and one like a son of man given an everlasting kingdom.

chapters.title: The ram and the goat
chapters.summary: A vision of a ram and a goat pictures Persia and Greece, and a proud horn that opposes God's people until it is broken.

chapters.title: Daniel's prayer
chapters.summary: Reading Jeremiah, Daniel confesses Israel's sins and pleads for mercy. Gabriel brings a word about seventy weeks.

chapters.title: A heavenly messenger
chapters.summary: After three weeks of mourning, Daniel sees a glorious messenger who tells him he is greatly loved and strengthens him.

chapters.title: Kings of north and south
chapters.summary: A detailed vision of wars between kings of the north and south, and a proud ruler who exalts himself above every god.

chapters.title: The time of the end
chapters.summary: Michael will arise. Many who sleep in the dust will awake, and the wise will shine like the stars forever. Daniel is told to rest and await his reward.
